name: Spark Tiles
summary: A glass stat panel whose sparklines morph between ranges, scrub to any point and stream live
about: Four stat tiles for a small online shop: revenue in PKR, orders, visitors and conversion, each with a smooth sparkline. Switching between 7, 30 and 90 days dips the tiles in a wave, morphs every line with a little overshoot, counts the numbers and flips the change chips. Hover, drag or use the arrow keys on a line to read any point, turn on Compare for the period before, or Live to watch new points slide in.
how: Press 7D, 30D or 90D: the pill stretches across, the tiles dip and every line morphs while the numbers count.
Hover or drag along a sparkline (or focus it and use the arrow keys) to read the value and date of each point.
Press the compare button to draw the period before as a dashed line in every tile.
Turn on Live: a new point slides in every 1.6 seconds, the end dot rides to it and the totals tick.
The line at the bottom names the best day of the range and how orders moved.
